feeds.title: RACING & BREEDING IN INDIA | About time we caught up with the world!
feeds.description: I have been involved in Racing and Breeding in India for well over 30 years now and manage Dashmesh Stud Farm in Sarainaga which is located in Punjab, India. The primary reason for me to start this blog is because our sport in India is stagnating badly in the last few years and I wish to record my thoughts on a sport that I love as a fan and also as a source of livelihood.
